title: Premise gate
description: Normative contract for the coder-skill premise gate (PRs #946/#947). Two consumers: (1) this document IS a JSON Schema (draft-07) validating one premise telemetry record from the coder jsonl ($CODER_LOG_DIR/$(hostname -s).jsonl); (2) the x-gate-rules extension holds the normative judge constants -- the prose in SKILL.md references this file instead of restating field names or thresholds. Changing anything in x-gate-rules requires re-running scripts/premise-gate-battery.sh (9-state smoke battery, audit #946 section 5.6) before merge.

verdict.description: Scout's premise verdict after the judge confirm-ride (post-softening).

proposed_verdict.description: Judge choice-arm answer: proceed | proceed_with_deviation. Absent on fallback.

consistent.description: Judge premise_consistent noul (0..1), predicate-positive wording per x-gate-rules.question. Absent on fallback.

fallback.description: true when the judge was unavailable/failed and scout's verdict stood.

gate_decision.description: What the orchestrator actually did: stop (before PLAN), soften (falsified/blocked -> diverges), proceed. Recorded so audit #946 section 7 checkpoints can compute firing rate and stop precision without re-deriving from threshold prose.

x-gate-rules.question: Is the issue's premise consistent with this evidence?
x-gate-rules.polarity: predicate-positive -- the dangerous 'yes' must mean proceed, never stop (audit #946 section 5.6; arXiv 2306.08189, 2601.13537, 2509.08480)
x-gate-rules.stop_rule: scout falsified/blocked stands as a stop only if premise_consistent noul <= stop_threshold; above it the stop softens to diverges
x-gate-rules.never_create_stop: scout sound proceeds as sound regardless of noul; the judge may confirm or soften a stop but never create one
x-gate-rules.disagreement_rule: noul >= disagreement_threshold on a scout-sound verdict is surfaced as scout-judge disagreement at presentation
x-gate-rules.choice_arm: separates proceed from proceed_with_deviation only; NEVER decides stops
x-gate-rules.fallback: never fatal: judge unavailable/API failure/{fallback: true} envelope -> scout's verdict stands, log fallback: true
x-gate-rules.telemetry: {stage: 'premise', verdict, proposed_verdict, consistent, fallback, gate_decision} appended to the same jsonl as SKILL.md Constraint #10; never block on logging failures; on fallback omit proposed_verdict/consistent or set them to null
